components.name: Input x
components.description: Vector in ℝ^D that enters the system.

components.name: Encoder V^T
components.description: Yellow trapezoid block that projects the input from ℝ^D to ℝ^d using the matrix V^T.

components.name: Neural Network f_θ
components.description: Central box representing a multilayer neural network that processes the encoded vector together with time t.

components.name: Decoder V
components.description: Green trapezoid block that projects the latent vector from ℝ^d back to ℝ^D using matrix V.

components.name: Addition Node ⊕
components.description: Circular node that sums the shortcut signal and the decoder output.

components.name: Output s_{V,θ}(x,t)
components.description: Final output of the diagram produced after the addition node.

components.name: Time t
components.description: Auxiliary scalar input fed into the neural network f_θ.
